name: Pit Lane
tagline: Race a King down a row of cards; loot the track or sprint for the flag.
core_loop: Play a card to drive 1-2 spaces, slipstream past rivals, and pocket the track card it matches by suit or rank; or spend the turn refuelling your hand.
win_condition: Highest total of distance points plus pocketed card values when a racer crosses the finish line.
